hypotheses.claim: Default native PDF export compressed/resampled the logo
hypotheses.observed: Original pale-portrait PDF:338x338 DCTDecode RGB; lossless/no-reduction PDF:2687x2687 FlateDecode RGB
hypotheses.conclusion: Compression is real, but disabling it does not repair visibility. Compression alone is insufficient as an explanation.

hypotheses.claim: Native font fallback comes from an unpinned offline font environment
hypotheses.observed: Same immutable PPTX with pinned fontconfig exports Verdana and Verdana-Bold in all six native PDFs; original substituted control is rejected
hypotheses.conclusion: Font-family substitution is resolved for these offline controls. Glyph/ink/wrap/bidi/Canva/human fidelity is not certified.
